name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's path to motorsport was unconventional, initially finding success as a data analyst in the automotive industry. His keen eye for detail and ability to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets led him to Formula racing, where he quickly established himself as a promising strategist. He's worked with several mid-tier teams, helping them punch above their weight through clever race-day calls and innovative pit stop strategies.

Kenji is known for his calm demeanor, even under immense pressure. He approaches each race with a meticulously prepared plan, but remains flexible enough to adapt to changing conditions. His distinctive approach involves combining data-driven analysis with an understanding of driver psychology, allowing him to make decisions that maximize both performance and morale. He is a valuable asset to any team seeking an edge in race strategy.

What sets Kenji apart is his ability to make difficult calls with confidence and conviction. His willingness to challenge conventional wisdom, while maintaining a collaborative team environment, is what makes him a desirable addition to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Kenji is of average height and build, often seen wearing spectacles.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus for quick calculations.
Insists on drinking green tea before every race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
